typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MEMBERLIST_IID BIGINT  INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,?);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();  INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE) SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,M.MEMBER_IID,MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE FROM PDS_MEMBER M 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON M.MEMBER_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID 		AND M.MEMBER_MCARE_ELIGIBILITY_IND = 1 		AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_CPSUI_VERIFIED_DT <DATEADD(DAY,-3,GETDATE()) 		AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER CMM ON CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID 		AND CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE = MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE 		AND CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID IN (SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND = 1) WHERE CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_IID IS NULL GROUP BY M.MEMBER_IID,MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE  SELECT \'HR|SIF000100|\' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) + \'|100166|102|200|200|100|1|EnterpriseReporting|PDS\' AS DATAROW UNION ALL SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE + \'|\' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_IID) AS DATAROW FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID= @MEMBERLIST_IID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDNC
PDSDNC sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = DATAROW)) ~> FlatFileDestination
